dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed 4-6 light-tan 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters on the posterior-lateral flank with sharp gradient transitions from high-intensity exterior lines to dark interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity light clusters concentrated along the mid-ventral margin, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the upper posterior flank form a scalene triangle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single linear reddish-pink mark on the upper pectoral flipper.
other_distinctive_markers: Series of prominent transverse skin folds on the anterior portion of the trunk.
